note: Digital Soul (Han, October 2023). The work is the return of artpiece() on the artist's own contract (no token standard, no token URI), read by its web3:// URL (ERC-4804) at block 26314355 with calldata 0x37a908fc; record in web3-read.json. A call has no content address, so the read is pinned to the block and the trust is the node's.
